### The Ultimate Lifesaver
Author: Jim Liebelt
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/the-ultimate-lifesaver-homeword-june-28.html
Passage: John 15:13
Points:
- True heroism is revealed when someone willingly puts their life on the line for others.
- Jesus demonstrated the ultimate act of love by dying on the cross to rescue humanity from sin.
- Through His resurrection, Christ conquered death and secured salvation for all who believe.
- Those who have received His rescue are commissioned to help rescue others.
- Believers can live out their gratitude by sharing Christ’s rescue story with people around them.

### Friendship’s Ultimate Gift
Author: Leslie Snyder
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-august-25-2016.html
Passage: John 15:13-14
Points:
- Sacrificial friendship means willingly bearing burdens alongside and on behalf of others.
- Jesus reached into broken humanity to extend genuine friendship to unlikely followers.
- On the cross, Christ carried the full weight of sin and laid down His life for His friends.
- Being counted as a friend of Jesus involves reciprocal loyalty through obedience to His commands.
